from itertools import accumulate
from math import gcd


def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    s = list(accumulate(a, initial=0))
    q: list[int] = []
    head = 0
    best_p = s[k]
    best_q = k

    for r in range(k, n + 1):
        j = r - k
        sj = s[j]
        while len(q) - head >= 2:
            i1 = q[-2]
            i2 = q[-1]
            if (s[i2] - s[i1]) * (j - i2) >= (sj - s[i2]) * (i2 - i1):
                q.pop()
            else:
                break
        q.append(j)

        sr = s[r]
        while len(q) - head >= 2:
            i1 = q[head]
            i2 = q[head + 1]
            if (sr - s[i2]) * (r - i1) >= (sr - s[i1]) * (r - i2):
                head += 1
            else:
                break

        l = q[head]
        p = sr - s[l]
        q_len = r - l
        if p * best_q > best_p * q_len:
            best_p = p
            best_q = q_len

    g = gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // g, best_q // g]
